claim_set.claim_text: Every AI-flagged or AI-interpreted pathology finding MUST map to a named pathologist with the prescribed authority before it enters the diagnostic record. Findings lacking named-pathologist sign-off are refused at the action-admissibility gate.

Every material AI-assisted whole-slide-image interpretation decision MUST emit a signed, replay-derivable Evidence Pack binding owner identity, the model and version that produced the finding, the clinical obligation discharged, and the Authority Finality outcome.

Every change to the model, algorithm, or version of a deployed pathology Software as a Medical Device MUST be authorised under a Predetermined Change Control Plan with named authority and supporting evidence before rollout.
Every AI-assisted access to pathology personal data (including whole-slide images and embedded identifiers) MUST be purpose-scoped and minimised to what the declared clinical purpose requires.
